scope.claim_boundary: Current Windows evidence through two bounded runs: three-session/two-worktree coordination pilot plus a serial paired profile mechanism test. The broad minimal flag bundle was directly falsified for this read-only worker because it removed required execution-policy behavior, failed the verifier, retained skill discovery, and increased tokens/time. Reliability, per-flag causality, Desktop managed-worktree operations, handoff, archive, subagent, active-turn, dirty-state, restart, and ordering remain untested.

capabilities.claim: In the current Desktop session, list can locate this active project task and read returns its task identity/status, while a nonexistent thread ID produces an explicit not-found failure.
limitations: No reliability rate or archived/paginated/stale-host behavior established
Does not imply mutation or coordination capabilities
capabilities.failure_policy: Treat not-found and host mismatch as explicit failures; never infer success from an empty task result.

capabilities.claim: In this environment, codex exec -C can create persisted read-only CLI sessions whose reported and Desktop-observed cwd is the requested manual worktree.
limitations: Filesystem cwd does not isolate global memory, skills, plugins, Git user config, or Codex session storage
Desktop saved-project registration did not occur
capabilities.failure_policy: Independently verify cwd, branch, HEAD, status, and allowed roots; do not treat -C as full runtime isolation.

capabilities.claim: Selecting a separate cwd and read-only sandbox is sufficient to give a CLI worker a minimal, self-contained runtime context.
limitations: The runs prove context loading and one unsafe broad ablation, not that every loaded component affected the answer
A profile preserving execution policy while narrowing discovery is pending
capabilities.failure_policy: Budget and audit global context separately from workspace isolation; use a controlled profile only after verifying required auth and policies remain available.

capabilities.claim: Ignoring user config and disabling memories, plugins, and skill_search is a safe lower-context bootstrap for the fixed read-only worker task.
limitations: The bundle changes four settings together
A different curated profile may still be useful
capabilities.failure_policy: Do not use this bundle as a default; preserve execution policy and reintroduce one-at-a-time context ablations only under a fixed verifier.

capabilities.failure_policy: Use changed plus latest-turn state to distinguish new work; do not treat inactiveStatus alone as a new completion.

behavior_test_authorization.reason: The user explicitly requested an independent directory for all dispatched sessions and worktrees and authorized continuation. The first run used three sessions/two worktrees; a separately preregistered serial profile comparison added two sessions and no worktrees. All sessions used the lab worktrees; no deletion or project-checkout worker write occurred.
